jmiller: quick request — need temp sudo on prod-console to debug redaction bug, ~30m. scope: console read + psql readonly. start 2026-03-17T10:30:00Z end 2026-03-17T11:00:00Z. justification: investigate missing redaction in telemetry exports.

 tchen: can you add the incident/jira link and the exact commands you'll run? also add an audit tag (policy req).

 jmiller: INF-1234 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234. audit_tag=ephemeralDebug_INF1234. commands:
```
psql -h prod-db -U readonly -c "select id, event, payload from user_events where event='export' order by created_at desc limit 20;"
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=telemetry --since=1h | grep -i export | head -n 50
```
I'll redact PII before sharing.

 security-bot: policy reminder: temporary elevations require start/end times, justification, and role name. All sessions recorded. See /policies/ephemeral-access. I'll auto-create audit entry when approved.

 ops-oncall: ok to approve but change to readonly only (no write, no secret unwrap). create role: ephem_debug_INF1234_ro. I'll provision for 35m to account for latency.

 jmiller: sounds good — no secret unwrap. ack to role name. update start to 2026-03-17T10:32:00Z end 2026-03-17T11:07:00Z

 rachel: quick reminder — if you need to copy logs out, scrub user_id and email. Reach out if you need help with redaction script (I can paste a sed/awk snippet).

 jmiller: thanks all, will post audit link + snippets (redacted) when done. :thumbsup:

 security-bot: SEC-AUDIT created SEC-7890; link: https://redwood.sec/audit/SEC-7890. session role ephem_debug_INF1234_ro pending grant.
